note: Cases for collide-param-decision.dmn (probe E3). 2 cases x 3 decisions = 6
value checks. The expectations are written for the DMN-conformant reading:
a BKM may not silently read a decision (via_reader would then be null, and
the engines are being asked which they do), and the parameter shadows the
decision name (via_shadow = 2000, not 7000 or 8000). Where an engine
differs, THAT is the measurement; read the recorded run, not this note.
